definitions.explanation: A layer of sedimentary rock or soil with internally consistent characteristics that distinguishes it from adjacent layers.

examples.english: Strata from millions of years ago are visible on this cliff.

examples.japanese: {地層|ちそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦わかる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: By studying the geological strata, we can understand the environment of the past.

examples.japanese: ⟦{化石|かせき}→化石：11796_kaseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}→特定：04275_tokutei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地層|ちそう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Fossils are discovered from specific geological strata.

notes:
USAGE: {地層|ちそう} is a technical term used in geology and earth science to describe layers of rock and sediment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{地層|ちそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧ (to examine strata)
・{地層|ちそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{堆積|たいせき}→堆積：29631_taiseki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (strata accumulate)
・{地層|ちそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{断面|だんめん}→断面：21317_danmen⟧ (cross-section of strata)
・{地層|ちそう}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧ (geological survey)

・⟦{堆積岩|たいせきがん}→堆積岩：23353_taisekigan⟧ - sedimentary rock
・⟦{化石|かせき}→化石：11796_kaseki⟧ - fossil

・⟦{褶曲|しゅうきょく}→褶曲：29635_shuukyoku⟧ - fold (geological)
